restaurant_name: คลินิกกายภาพบำบัดยูนิคแคร์สเตชันเชียงใหม่
text:
This isn't a treatment clinic anymore.
It's more of a place to sell products and treatment courses.

I went there with shoulder pain that had led to headaches.
They did a full body examination and asked questions for half an hour, followed by another half hour of trying to sell treatment courses.
If you don't buy a course, the cost per session is very expensive.
It's not suitable for trying out treatments at all.
And if you buy a course, you have to have at least 10 sessions, and there's no guarantee of effectiveness, and the cost is in the tens of thousands of baht.

I had headaches and was forced to decide between treatment options – paying upfront and buying a course. Ultimately, I didn't decide to buy anything.
It felt like I was being pressured into making a decision.

The place lacked ventilation, had no view, and was claustrophobic with dark curtains. I didn't feel like the staff or physiotherapists cared much about the patients' conditions.
Even as I was leaving, they kept trying to sell me courses, insisting I was already there.
I felt disgusted.
Oh, and if you leave a five-star review, you'll get an additional 500 baht discount.
Before coming to the clinic, an admin called offering a 1000 baht discount. It could be used for individual sessions or courses, but compared to the money I would have to pay, that 1000 baht was practically irrelevant.
